stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The object was not famous, but it was human.”?
options: Sometimes the smallest historical items create the strongest connection because they show daily life rather than power.
A city that ignores toilets may look modern while making daily life harder for many people.
The little details of a person's daily life can become familiar to others.
It showed that human mistakes can sometimes be managed and healed, but only through long-term responsibility.
